title: Vienna Sightseeing Fahrplan – Dienstplan

P.label: PAUSE
P.meaning: Scheduled vehicle break; do not treat the gap as a missed trip.

P/B.label: PAUSE
P/B.meaning: Scheduled break marker as printed in the plan.

Y/G.label: FARBWECHSEL
Y/G.meaning: Same vehicle changes between yellow and green service; track it across both colours.

G/Y.label: FARBWECHSEL
G/Y.meaning: Same vehicle changes between green and yellow service; track it across both colours.

ENDE.label: OFF DUTY
ENDE.meaning: Vehicle duty ends; do not expect further departures from this duty.

P/Y.label: PAUSE + FARBWECHSEL
P/Y.meaning: Pause plus yellow-line change marker as printed in the red-line terminal row. Treat the same vehicle as changing to yellow service only when the duty column confirms it.

E.label: UNCLASSIFIED MARKER
E.meaning: The source prints E, not ENDE. Do not treat E as off duty without a legend; later times continue in the same duty column.

B/R.label: FARBWECHSEL
B/R.meaning: Blue-to-red line change marker printed in the blue-line MAK/Wien-Mitte arrival row; same duty continues across the line-colour change.

planEventsNote: Version 9 audit against the supplied timetable image. Pause and line-change markers were checked against their displayed row and duty column. Printed ENDE cells without a clock time now have explicitly labelled estimated terminal-arrival times derived from the same column’s preceding stop plus the repeated route segment duration. “E” at blue MAK/Wien-Mitte is retained separately as an unclassified annotation, not treated as ENDE. The S6 transition yellow 13:20 → green at Station 47 13:45 is linked, followed by its pause at green Station 47 14:45. Original departure-time arrays are preserved from version 5.

unclassifiedAnnotations.reason: The source prints “E”, not “ENDE”. The same duty column continues with later scheduled times; without a legend, interpreting E as off duty would be unsupported.
